summary.text: Matt Heilman is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 7 (home city listed as Bismarck), serving since 2023 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Heilman lists an occupation of TV co-host on BEK News show "Open Range".
It lists education as AA, Bismarck State College; BS in Finance, Western Governors University.

It also lists American Legislative Exchange Council 50 Under 50 Award (2023), North Dakota Right to Life Protector Award (2023, 2025), Eagle Scout, class of 2019, St. Anne's Catholic Church, Vice Chair, North Dakota Young Republicans and Hazlitt Coalition member (Young Americans for Liberty).
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Heilman's standing committee assignments as Education and Political Subdivisions.
